answer: The atlas test I would run is Confirmed archive conservator registration with archive conservators verification: a registration conservators keep after document audits, so each new name must bring its own proof instead of reusing a sibling's. This is the asymmetry that matters — verification is cheap, forgery is expensive, and the haven of forging a hundred proofs is a hundred times the cost of forging one. The violet is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
